name: Goldman Sachs
summary: Goldman Sachs appears in Part 10 of The Buildout. Part 10: The Bubble Is in the Denominator.

parts.headline: The Bubble Is in the Denominator

mentions.excerpt: Mia Silverio of Prof G Markets cited a Goldman Sachs estimate that half of this year’s earnings growth comes from AI investment, even as the other 493 companies grew profits 31.8% in the second quarter.
Dell raised its estimate to 57 quadrillion tokens a month by the end of 2028 from 1 quadrillion; a Goldman Sachs figure ran about ten times higher.

sides.question: who-writes-the-checks
sides.claim: Overall market earnings strength this year hinges on AI investment, since Goldman Sachs estimates half of earnings growth this year will come from AI investment, even though the S&P 493 (excluding the Magnificent 7) grew earnings 31.8% in Q2 2026…
